# Tiny checked HDiv fixture

`hex_pair.vol` is an independently authored pair of unit hexahedra with one conforming quadrilateral interface and ten exterior faces. It is generated by `connected_mesh("hex-pair")` in `tests/test_hdiv_connected_meshes.py` with Netgen/NGSolve 6.2.2608. Labels are `body` and `exterior`. The required small fixture supports real label-checker filename/compression regressions without requiring NGSolve in that test process. Larger numerical runs belong in `validation_test/`.

The tracked export normalizes trailing whitespace and the final newline only; mesh tokens are unchanged. Historical validation result hashes identify the original generated artifact, not these normalized text bytes.
